channel.title: The Grant Desk - Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, Africa, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, Africa, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 6 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 01 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Goethe-Institut: Africa-Europe Mobility Grants (15 June 2026 Cut-Off)
    https://www.goethe.de/prj/aep/en/cal/ssa/mga.html
    Goethe-Institut (with Expertise France and Institut francais) · deadline Closed 15 Jun 2026 · Up to EUR 4,000 per mobility. Eligible costs: travel (including visa and insurance), accommodation, subsistence, digital costs, and top-up support for family, disability, and green mobility. No application fee.
  • Connect and Create: Professional Mobilities for Performing Arts (Africa-Europe) - 30 June 2026 Cut-Off
    https://ifprog.emundus.fr/en/campagne-info?view=programme&cid=311
    Goethe-Institut and Expertise France, in collaboration with Institut francais (Africa-Europe Partnerships for Culture consortium) · deadline Closed 30 Jun 2026 · EUR 15,000 to EUR 25,000 per hosting organisation, covering travel, visa and insurance costs for delegation members. No application fee.
